description: Single source for the task-discipline hooks. Policy lives in scripts/agent-system/hooks/core.mjs; each provider entry names a thin wrapper and the provider event it runs on. `npm run agent:generate` writes .agents/hooks.json and the managed entries of .claude/settings.json; `check:control-plane` fails on drift.

guards.purpose: Block secret reads, main pushes and destructive git from the shell.
guards.claudeEquivalent: Unmanaged PreToolUse hooks in .claude/settings.json (guard-bash-secret-read, guard-main-push, guard-secrets), run in exec form through scripts/hook-fail-closed.mjs so any failure blocks; the same read guard on the PowerShell tool (guard-bash-secret-read --powershell), plus permissions.deny.

guards.purpose: Block a file-tool read of a secret: a path that names one, or a wildcard that could expand to one (doc 36 S2). Only the tools that return contents are matched.
guards.claudeEquivalent: permissions.deny Read() rules on secret paths in .claude/settings.json.

guards.purpose: Ledger every file write for the Stop gate and classify risk from the written paths; a vendor-integration or dependency path waits until research is captured.
Advisory only (doc 34 W3), arms no gate: Claude notes an R3+ reading of the prompt, §B verify items and OPEN lessons; Antigravity repeats the research steps after a refused vendor write.
After any write since the gate last settled, run the related tests and tsc for the written paths, then the evidence check; at most 2 consecutive blocks, then stop with an UNVERIFIED notice.
